text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса exhausts everything she's
got to
beat Сайленс Судзука.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So much so, in fact, that she passes out
from
pushing herself beyond her limits.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
One thing has become painfully clear to
El
Condor Pasa—if there are racers like
Silence
Suzuka at the Japan Cup, she
doesn't stand a
chance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She hangs her head dejectedly as she
decides to
give up on her goal of
winning the Japan Cup in
her classic
year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
